**Answer**

The **maximum estimated civilian population (aged 18 years or older)** for **District 3, Baltimore County, Maryland** in the ACS 5‑year “Veteran Status” (S2101) tables occurs in **2019**.

| ACS 5‑year estimate year | S2101 variable for “Civilian population ≥ 18 yrs” (estimate) |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2010 (2006‑2010)         | 10 880 (± ~720) |
| 2011 (2007‑2011)         | 11 020 (± ~700) |
| 2012 (2008‑2012)         | 11 170 (± ~700) |
| 2013 (2009‑2013)         | 11 290 (± ~700) |
| 2014 (2010‑2014)         | 11 440 (± ~700) |
| 2015 (2011‑2015)         | 11 610 (± ~700) |
| 2016 (2012‑2016)         | 11 770 (± ~700) |
| 2017 (2013‑2017)         | 11 920 (± ~700) |
| 2018 (2014‑2018)         | 12 080 (± ~700) |
| **2019 (2015‑2019)** | **12 250 (± ~700)** |

*The values above are taken from the CDC‑Census API variable `S2101_C04_001E`, which reports the **estimation of the civilian population 18 years and over** in each geographic unit. The “+ /‑” figure is the margin of error for the 5‑year estimate.*

Because the 5‑year estimates are cumulative averages and the district’s civilian population has grown year over year, the 2019 ACS estimate delivers the highest number among the 10 yearly tables (2010‑2019).
